changelog.text: Cosmetics clicks fixed. The tabs down the side and the + buttons now react to exactly where they're drawn. And if you were matching your partner's outfit, picking something yourself now stops matching (it used to put their outfit back on you every couple of seconds, so it looked like the buttons did nothing). Turn matching back on with the button at the top.

34 new cosmetics and a new Tails tab. Tails: cat, fox, bunny, devil, dragon and robot, and they swish as you walk. Hats: witch, cowboy, party, flower crown, frog, headphones and a star crown. Glasses: heart, round, star, snow goggles and a monocle. Ears: bear, devil horns, bug antennae and elf. Wings: fairy, dragon and crystal. Auras: heart orbit, planet rings, leaf swirl and spirit flames. Capes: Moonlit Sea, Inferno, Rainbow, Night Forest and Racer. Shared tails show for other Lmg players too.

Pets climb on you. One setting: You > Outfit > Pets climb on me. Your pets on Follow hop up onto your head and shoulders one after another, sit there a while, then hop down and walk about. Players climbing on each other is gone: the Climbing page, its key and the asking are all removed, and so is everything the server kept for it.

No more asking - and pets play too. Climbing is a setting now: Social > Climbing > Who can climb on me (nobody, your partner, friends or everyone). Pets can be set to Play around me, and pets on Follow come and play when you stand still: hopping round you, bouncing, nuzzling up, then sitting beside you.

Climb on anyone (who says yes). You don't need to be friends or partners any more: look at someone with Lmg and climb - they get a little card asking, and press Y (yes for 2 hours), U (always) or N (no). See who can climb on you, clear it, or stop people asking, in Social > Climbing.

Partners, closer. If your partner says yes (Social > Partner > Let my partner climb on me), you can sit on their head or their shoulder. Stand still next to them for a bit and you start playing around them: hopping round, pulling their arm, poking them, then sitting down together. Other Lmg players see it too.
